versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-ozon-category-search-skill for Ozon category research using 极鲸云.
- Supports querying synced category trees, details, parent chains, market size, and historical data for Ozon.
- Defaults to Russian site if not specified; allows platform and site switching.
- Only confirmed category IDs are used, with a maximum of 200 products accessed per query.
- Includes references for metric definitions, operational policies, and query pause/resume process.
- Results clarify that empty outputs do not imply absence on the platform.
